title: MapleStory Idle RPG Companions Guide
author: MapleStory Idle RPG Wiki contributors
summary: A companion-system guide covering rarity, active and passive bonuses, main and sub slots, cooldown behavior, leveling, and content-specific selection.

sections.title: Slots and activation
items: The main companion contributes its active behavior and equipped bonus.
Sub companions primarily contribute equipped bonuses.

sections.title: Rarity and growth
items: Duplicates raise companion levels over time.
Rarity corresponds to advancement tiers and affects available power.

sections.title: Content presets
items: Normal-stage, boss, and Arena needs are different.
Test a preset against the exact content rather than relying on one universal lineup.

notes: Strategy recommendations are community-maintained and may evolve with new companions.
steps: Review owned companion rarity and level.
Choose a main companion for the target content.
Fill sub slots with useful equipped bonuses.
